definitions.explanation: Describing an attitude or behavior that pushes back against authority, ideas, or pressure.
Describing a physical or psychological force that pushes things apart or away.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{上司|じょうし}に{反発的|はんぱつてき}な{態度|たいど}を{取|と}った。
examples.english: He took a defiant attitude toward his boss.

examples.japanese: {思春期|ししゅんき}の{子供|こども}は{親|おや}に{反発的|はんぱつてき}になりやすい。
examples.english: Adolescent children tend to become resistant toward their parents.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{政策|せいさく}に{対|たい}して{市民|しみん}は{反発的|はんぱつてき}な{反応|はんのう}を{示|しめ}した。
examples.english: Citizens showed a resistant reaction to the new policy.

examples.japanese: {同|おな}じ{極|きょく}の{磁石|じしゃく}は{反発的|はんぱつてき}だ。
この{素材|そざい}は{水|みず}に{対|たい}して{反発的|はんぱつてき}な{性質|せいしつ}を{持|も}つ。
examples.english: This material has a water-repellent property.

examples.japanese: {二|ふた}つの{集団|しゅうだん}の{間|あいだ}には{反発的|はんぱつてき}な{力|ちから}が{働|はたら}いている。
examples.english: A repulsive force is at work between the two groups.

notes:
A na-adjective formed from {反発|はんぱつ} (repulsion; resistance) plus {的|てき}. Sense 1 describes psychological or social resistance, while sense 2 describes physical repulsion. The word {反発|はんぱつ} itself has both meanings, and the adjective inherits them.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {反発的|はんぱつてき}な{態度|たいど}: resistant attitude
- {反発的|はんぱつてき}な{反応|はんのう}: oppositional reaction
- {反発的|はんぱつてき}な{力|ちから}: repulsive force
- {反発的|はんぱつてき}になる: to become defiant

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {反抗的|はんこうてき}: rebellious; defiant — stronger than {反発的|はんぱつてき}, implying active resistance against authority
- {敵対的|てきたいてき}: hostile; antagonistic — implies deeper hostility rather than mere resistance
- {批判的|ひはんてき}: critical — intellectual opposition through analysis rather than emotional pushback
